applicabilityReason: 8-token 4-cohort relational source routing, sealed continuous payload codebook perturbation, 6-stage Hamming transfer probe, and bounded 38889-settle execution require explicit identity and evidence accounting.

selectedRules.applicabilityReason: Shared native 48-source reuse, 8-token 4-cohort domain routing, order-normalized query slot alignment between r39 and r40, and sealed payload immutability require full source/role/revision/config binding without host truth repair.

Information-matched exact control and complete accounting of source, 6-stage transfer probe, upper relational pipeline, storage, audit, and seal costs without efficiency or R40 cost-adoption overclaims.

facts.statement: R37-R43 relational pipelines used only 6 of 8 tokens (omitting codes 6,7) and fixed intra-domain XORs to 1 (0^1=2^3=4^5=1), so 100% of mismatch role comparisons occurred at Hamming distance d=1 and pair gates only saw 4 of 16 (d1,d2) pairs ({0,1}^2).

In r39/r40, produce() seals continuous floating-point arrays (slices, factors, xy/z) with payload_sha256 before isolated consume(). Symmetric 4-cohort domains (omitting {5,6},{3,4},{1,2},{0,7}) activate all 8 tokens, induce 8/8 distinct restricted maps per base, and expose all 16/16 Hamming pairs while reusing unmodified r39/r40 runtime.execute.

48 fresh lower sources + 569 6-stage transfer probe settles (role 64 + pair 16 + or0..4 121 + triple 64 + projection 272 + consume 32) + 128 cases across 3 native arms (38272 settles) = 38889 total physical native settles (+ 128 exact). 600s total / 240s stage / raw 128MiB / cache 128MiB / AS 512MiB / LRU 18 / worker 1 / retry 0.

invariants.statement: Only token-to-code map, order-aligned query slots, and grounded 48-source 8-token 4-cohort inputs are supplied to unchanged r39/r40 execute; core/learner/AST/Config/initial 0.5/guards/controller/history/Cost are unchanged. Every base case must induce 8/8 distinct restricted maps (0 unchanged pairs), all 8 tokens must be balanced across 3/4 cohorts, and invalid maps or collapsed coverage reject.

invariants.statement: 64 role inputs partition into 4 Hamming classes d in {0,1,2,3}; 16 pair settles exhaust all 4^2 Hamming-pair drives for all 40320 bijections; or0..4(121), triple(64), projection(272), and consume(32) audit the 6-stage extremal scalar envelope without claiming 64^n enumeration. designChoices.statement: Use symmetric 4-cohort domains omitting {5,6},{3,4},{1,2},{0,7} across 48 grounded sources with unmodified r39/r40 execute across native_joint, native_factor, native_compact, and exact_joint, plus a 569-settle 6-stage transfer probe and 22-mutation pre-freeze check.
designChoices.rationale: Guarantees 8/8 restricted maps per base, balanced 8-token activation, all d in {0,1,2,3} per codebook, and 16/16 Hamming pairs while testing all three sealed payload schemas (slices, factors, xy/z) in 38889 physical settles.
